ModManifest.Name: Redrawn Studio
ModManifest.Author: Evans Goethe
ModManifest.Description:
Redrawn Studio — Independent portrait manager. F9 opens the English / Traditional Chinese Studio. No prerequisite mods.
Special thanks to RetroAnime (Retro Anime, Workshop 3832229198) and Portrait Studio by Flaming (Workshop 3829932963). RetroAnime served as a technical reference for native mod loading, high-resolution portrait replacement and bottom-centred scaling. Portrait Studio inspired independent special-guest portraits, live switching, layout adjustment, the management interface and multi-source management. Development drew on examination of their distributed mod structures, configuration formats and compiled assembly behaviour, with AI-assisted implementation. This project does not bundle either reference mod's DLL or artwork; neither is a required dependency. Compatible external portrait packs can be used as optional sources.
AI disclosure: Redrawn Studio was developed using AI-assisted vibe coding with OpenAI ChatGPT, under Evans Goethe's direction, including implementation, debugging, UI development, localisation and compatibility work. The original Redrawn portrait artwork is drawn by Evans Goethe.
Redrawn Studio — 獨立立繪管理器；按 F9 開啟繁體中文／英文介面。無前置模組依賴。
特別感謝 RetroAnime（Retro Anime，工作坊 3832229198）及 Flaming 開發的 Portrait Studio（工作坊 3829932963）。本專案參考 RetroAnime 的遊戲原生模組載入、高解析度立繪替換與底部置中縮放方式；並參考 Portrait Studio 的特殊客人獨立立繪、即時切換、位置與大小校準、管理介面及多來源管理設計。開發過程分析兩者已發行的模組結構、配置格式及編譯後程式集的行為，並以 AI 輔助實作。本專案未內附兩者的 DLL 或美術素材，亦不將其列為必要前置模組；相容的外部立繪包可作為選用來源。
AI 使用聲明：Redrawn Studio 採用 AI 輔助的 Vibe Coding 開發方式，由 Evans Goethe 主導需求與功能設計，透過 OpenAI ChatGPT 協助程式實作、除錯、介面開發、在地化及相容性處理。Redrawn 原創角色立繪由 Evans Goethe 親自繪製。
